say.en: You decide to lift your arm, and it moves. Your heart beats a hundred thousand times a day without your asking. Your stomach churns food on its own. Three kinds of muscle are at work. In this lesson: Compare skeletal, smooth and cardiac muscle.
Describe neurons and neuroglia.

body.en: *Muscle* tissue is made of long, cylindrical fibres arranged in parallel, each made of fine myofibrils; the fibres contract in response to stimulation and then relax. Skeletal muscle is attached to bones and is striated, with bundles wrapped in tough connective tissue, as in the biceps. Smooth muscle fibres taper at both ends, are not striated, and are found in the walls of blood vessels, the stomach and the intestine; they are involuntary. Cardiac muscle is found only in the heart; cell junctions fuse the plasma membranes of its cells so that they contract as a unit.
body.kn: ಅಸ್ಥಿಪಂಜರ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆಯುಳ್ಳದ್ದು, ಮೂಳೆಗೆ ಅಂಟಿದೆ (ಬೈಸೆಪ್ಸ್). ನಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆರಹಿತ, ಅನೈಚ್ಛಿಕ; ರಕ್ತನಾಳ, ಜಠರ, ಕರುಳಿನ ಗೋಡೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ. ಹೃದಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ; ಕೋಶ ಸಂಧಿಗಳಿಂದ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಸಂಕುಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

explanation.en: Muscle tissue contracts and relaxes; neural tissue controls the body's responsiveness. Tissues form organs, and organs work together as organ systems.

body.en: *Neural tissue* exerts the greatest control over the body's responsiveness to changing conditions. Neurons are the excitable cells: when suitably stimulated, an electrical disturbance travels swiftly along the plasma membrane. Neuroglial cells protect and support the neurons and make up more than half the volume of neural tissue in our body.

body.en: Tissues are organised in specific proportions and patterns to form organs such as the stomach, lung, heart and kidney. Two or more organs working together by physical and chemical interaction form an organ system, such as the digestive or respiratory system. Cells, tissues, *organs and organ* systems divide the work of the body and help it survive.

points.kn: ಅಸ್ಥಿಪಂಜರ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆಯುಳ್ಳ, ಐಚ್ಛಿಕ; ನಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆರಹಿತ, ಅನೈಚ್ಛಿಕ.

points.en: Cardiac muscle is only in the heart and contracts as a unit.
points.kn: ಹೃದಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ; ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಸಂಕುಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Neurons are excitable; neuroglia support them.
Tissues form organs, and organs form organ systems.

homework.en: Draw the three types of muscle fibres and list three differences between them.

narration.en: Recap. Skeletal muscle is striated and voluntary; smooth is non-striated and involuntary. Cardiac muscle is only in the heart and contracts as a unit. Neurons are excitable; neuroglia support them. Tissues form organs, and organs form organ systems.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಅಸ್ಥಿಪಂಜರ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆಯುಳ್ಳ, ಐಚ್ಛಿಕ; ನಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆರಹಿತ, ಅನೈಚ್ಛಿಕ. ಹೃದಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ; ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಸಂಕುಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನರಕೋಶಗಳು ಉದ್ರೇಕಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ; ನ್ಯೂರೋಗ್ಲಿಯಾ ಆಧಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳಿಂದ ಅಂಗಗಳು, ಅಂಗಗಳಿಂದ ಅಂಗವ್ಯೂಹಗಳು.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Skeletal muscle is striated and voluntary; smooth is non-striated and involuntary.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಅಸ್ಥಿಪಂಜರ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆಯುಳ್ಳ, ಐಚ್ಛಿಕ; ನಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಪಟ್ಟೆರಹಿತ, ಅನೈಚ್ಛಿಕ.

say.en: Cardiac muscle is only in the heart and contracts as a unit.
say.kn: ಹೃದಯ ಸ್ನಾಯು ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ; ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಸಂಕುಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
